Class OrderQueue

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am43.model.board.OrderQueue
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class OrderQueue extends Object implements Serializable
The turn-order queue. Holds the players waiting to place their totem on the offer track and applies the food/prestige modifiers tied to each queue position.

  • Constructor Details

    • OrderQueue

      public OrderQueue(List<Player> players, List<Integer> foodModifiers, long seed) throws IllegalArgumentException
      Builds the queue, shuffling the players with the given seed and giving each one the increasing starting food bonus.
      Parameters:
      players - the players to enqueue
      foodModifiers - the food modifier for each queue position
      seed - the seed used to shuffle the players deterministically
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if players and modifiers have different sizes

      public void append(GameObserver observer, Player player)
      Appends a player to the back of the queue and applies the modifier of that position: positive/negative food if affordable, otherwise a -2 prestige penalty.
      Parameters:

      player - the player to enqueue
